thread.title: Dow jumps nearly 400 points to trade near session high as stock market awaits Fed update

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow jumps nearly 400 points to trade near session high as stock market awaits Fed update
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average midday Wednesday was trading near its highest intraday level ahead of monetary policy update from the Federal Reserve set for 2 p.m. Eastern Time. The Dow DJIA, +1.32% was most recently up by about 380 points, or 1.5%, at 24.957, tracking its best daily gain since Jan. 4, when the blue-chip benchmark surged 747 points, according to FactSet data. The Dow's gains were predominantly boosted by a surge in shares of industrial giant Boeing Co. BA, +6.83% and iPhone maker Apple Inc. AAPL, +5.30% after both reported quarterly results. The broader market also was in an updraft, with the S&P 500 index SPX, +0.88% rising 0.9% at 2,664, while the technology and internet-laden Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +1.32% advancing 1.1% at 7,106.
